name: triggers
meaning: trigger box list (Scn_FindIdList of the entry's first id property); FindEntryAt 0x4ab3cc skips an entry whose list is NULL, and reaching an entry with its disableEarlierMask bit set clears the earlier entries' lists

name: wolfDestination
meaning: Wolf's respawn box (PostLoadInit 0x4aba04-0x4abadb): its centre is sent with MSG_WOLF_SAVE_RESPAWN; NULL = the entry does not move Wolf's respawn

name: sheepDestination
meaning: the sheep's respawn box (PostLoadInit 0x4aba04-0x4abadb): its centre is sent with MSG_SHEEP_SAVE_RESPAWN; NULL = the entry does not move the sheep's respawn

name: yaw
meaning: orientation (4096/turn), converted from the entry's degrees property by PostLoadInit (0x4aba04-0x4abadb)
